name: Docker config.json registry credential entry
description: A registry credential entry in the Docker client configuration file config.json: the auths map's per-registry auth value (base64 of username:password), identity and registry tokens, and the credsStore and credHelpers references that keep credentials out of the file.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. A structured file, not a fixed-format token. The base64 layer is encoded material (#94); the decoded username-colon-password text is not given its own span here. The docker provider record is named Docker Hub; the config.json format belongs to the Docker client, so this family cites the docker/cli source as an official Docker repository.
